abilities.name: Find the Way
abilities.description: When you are tracking a creature, have gotten lost, don’t know the first step to take to begin a journey, or are attempting to choose between two or more routes to take, you can ask your GM one question about the task and get a very short, helpful answer. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until after your next recovery. Action.
